episodes.title: He Rides Again
episodes.summary: Following a personal and professional spiral, Los Angeles defense lawyer Mickey Haller receives an unexpected opportunity from a fellow attorney.

episodes.title: The Magic Bullet
episodes.summary: A high-profile murder trial sends Mickey scrambling to find evidence for his defense, while Maggie offers him a chance to help rebuild her trust.

episodes.title: Momentum
episodes.summary: Mickey looks for a link between the Trevor Elliott case and his mysterious new client, Lorna chases down a lead, and Cisco voices security concerns.

episodes.title: Chaos Theory
episodes.summary: After a close call at his office, Mickey hashes things out with Detective Griggs. A witness in Maggie's human trafficking case has second thoughts.

episodes.title: Twelve Lemmings in a Box
episodes.summary: Trevor's demands during jury selection frustrate Mickey, who reaches out for some unorthodox help. Cisco uncovers another person with a motive.

episodes.title: Bent
episodes.summary: As Mickey attempts to track down the source of a possible bribe, he meets with Lara's former colleague, revisits an old case and does a favor for Maggie.

episodes.title: Lemming Number Seven
episodes.summary: On the first day of Trevor's trial, Mickey tries to prove the police had tunnel vision. Maggie's new witness provides a lead. Lorna steps in with Hayley.

episodes.title: The Magic Bullet Redux
episodes.summary: After a damaging day of testimony, Mickey searches for the one piece of evidence that will crack his case wide open. Maggie faces a deadline on Soto.

episodes.title: The Uncanny Valley
episodes.summary: Determined to clear his name, Trevor pushes to take the stand, but the risky strategy leaves Mickey with more questions than answers.

episodes.title: The Brass Verdict
episodes.summary: Mickey confronts Trevor as the pieces fall into place, and his chance to right a past wrong could have dire consequences for Maggie.

episodes.title: The Rules of Professional Conduct
episodes.summary: Mickey meets a new client, receives a frustrating request and makes an instant connection with a chef. Lorna has her hands full juggling work and school.

episodes.title: Obligations
episodes.summary: Stuck in a sticky ethical dilemma, Mickey seeks advice from Legal Siegel and comes up with a strategy to help get a vulnerable client out of a scrape.

episodes.title: Conflicts
episodes.summary: Mickey has to think on his feet when he takes on a high-profile murder case against a razor-sharp prosecutor. Lorna can't shake her doubts about Cisco.

episodes.title: Discovery
episodes.summary: As his team hunts for a needle in a haystack to clear Lisa's name, Mickey comes up with a creative solution for a teenager accused of vandalism.

episodes.title: Suspicious Minds
episodes.summary: Cisco lays himself on the line for a friend. After pushing Andrea to show her cards in the courtroom, Mickey risks overplaying his hand.

episodes.title: Withdrawal
episodes.summary: While Mickey recovers from a brutal encounter, Izzy wrestles with regrets. Lorna devises an artful way to serve a subpoena. Maggie makes a huge decision.

episodes.title: Cui Bono
episodes.summary: As Lisa's trial begins, a mysterious letter left on Mickey's doorstep sends Cisco racing to verify a potentially game-changing piece of information.

episodes.title: Covenants and Stipulations
episodes.summary: Mickey reevaluates his trial strategy after Andrea unveils a key piece of evidence and an unexpected final witness. Hayley plans a birthday surprise.

episodes.title: The Fifth Witness
episodes.summary: After an unexpected witness gives emotional testimony on the stand, Mickey and Lorna hatch a clever plan to cast doubt on the prosecution's case.

episodes.title: Bury Your Past
episodes.summary: The defense rests, and a verdict is in — but Mickey still has more to learn about Lisa. Lorna and Cisco's wedding plans hit another hiccup.

episodes.title: La Culebra
episodes.summary: Mickey deliberates over representing the person accused of killing Gloria Dayton. Hayley asks her dad for help when her old babysitter is arrested.

episodes.title: Special Circumstances
episodes.summary: With everyone rattled by his dangerous new case, Mickey faces a major blow when an armed robbery trial turns violent. Julian's bail hearing hits a snag.

episodes.title: Strange Bedfellows
episodes.summary: While Lorna takes the bar exam, Mickey deals with a long-shot motion, a surprise subpoena and a skittish source. Andrea contends with a sensitive case.

episodes.title: Rearview Blind Spots
episodes.summary: Struggling with guilt as he tries to connect the dots in Gloria's murder, Mickey seeks advice from an old friend. Andrea receives devastating news.

episodes.title: What Happens in Victorville
episodes.summary: As Mickey sets a daring plan in motion involving a cartel boss, Lorna urges him to reach out to a besieged Andrea. Cisco tracks a witness in Las Vegas.

episodes.title: Man on Fire
episodes.summary: Mickey's team sets a trap as Julian's trial begins. Hayley blames her dad for a tragic loss, and Lorna receives her bar exam results.

episodes.title: Relevance
episodes.summary: A brutal day in court throws Mickey off his game. Lorna's new case sends her racing through the courthouse. Andrea confides in the wrong person.

episodes.title: Mystery Man
episodes.summary: When the judge rules a pivotal witness can testify, Mickey hatches a desperate plan to get a video admitted into evidence. Izzy gets a huge opportunity.

episodes.title: Ghosts
episodes.summary: With his client's fate uncertain and the DA demanding a mistrial, Mickey goes out on a legal limb to help sway the judge into letting the case continue.

episodes.title: The Gods of Guilt
episodes.summary: In a shocking twist, the missing pieces of Gloria's murder come together on the witness stand — but one last surprise leaves the entire courtroom shaken.
Mickey challenges the dubious traffic stop that landed him behind bars, as Haller and Associates strains under the weight of his looming murder trial.

episodes.title: Baja
episodes.summary: A combative bail hearing puts Mickey in the crosshairs of the Sheriff's Department. Cisco hatches a sweet scheme to bypass a backlog at the crime lab.

episodes.title: Forty Hours
episodes.summary: Mickey and Cisco race against time to pursue a mysterious lead. Lorna scours the fine print to score a win for her client. The firm hires a new driver.

episodes.title: Bleeding the Beast
episodes.summary: A court order compelling the release of records connected to the victim rouses Mickey's worst fears. Maggie confronts a former colleague.

episodes.title: You're the One That I Want
episodes.summary: Det. Drucker serves an ominous search warrant. Mickey applies leverage to extract sensitive information. Lorna juggles multiple crises at the firm.
A game-changing charge ups the stakes, forcing Mickey to make his toughest decision yet. Surveillance footage gives Izzy a new angle on the case.

episodes.title: Honor Among Thieves
episodes.summary: Secrets surface as Mickey cross-examines a key witness. Lorna gets a new case. Cisco hightails it to Palm Springs to serve a subpoena.

episodes.title: Confirmation Bias
episodes.summary: Mickey fears for his safety in the wake of a violent incident. Eyewitness testimony rattles Lorna's confidence. Izzy grills a green-energy expert.

episodes.title: October Surprise
episodes.summary: Maggie goes full McFierce as she locks horns with a volatile witness. A video shakes up Lorna's pretrial hearing. Mickey contemplates the unthinkable.

episodes.title: The Law of Innocence
episodes.summary: Boxed in between Death Row Dana and a full-on federal probe, Mickey makes a last-ditch gamble that could be his salvation — or his undoing.
